title: The Sleepy Hens
offer: Our hens sit sleepy in the corner and lay no eggs. You are healers now: what do they need? Ask Tova, and bring it.

steps.say: Sleepy hens? Lice, I bet. Dust baths with wood ash and a bit of garlic in the water. Here, take garlic.
Garlic water, ash baths, fresh grain... Cluck! An egg! You are real healers.

fact: Hens bathe in dust and ash to get rid of the little bugs in their feathers.
